# Draft:Object Invasion

Object Invasion is an American animated web series and object show created by FusionAnimations. The show is currently ongoing and follows 18 anthropomorphic objects competing in a reality show hosted by Tablet. Viewers vote who they want to be eliminated in a Google form.
